how_to_read.verdict: replace = a moment the player clearly notices, good spot for a Discord sound; optional = noticeable but frequent, long, a loop, 3rd-person only or partly shared, decide in design; keep = hits/impacts/foley/loops/enemy-only flybys/haptics, better left vanilla; unused = no S10 path found to it
how_to_read.variants: every moment lists the event and its _p2 (ally hears) and _p3 (enemy hears) versions. The plain event is what the local player hears; it usually has the main set plus a close-up sweetener layer and a source-plugin action (controller vibration), while _p2/_p3 play only a 3rd-person main set, often different media (and those 3P media are also in the 1037300/1037304 costume banks)
how_to_read.groups: one entry per set of alternatives that plays at the same time (random/switch container = pick one). role main = hirc_map.split_event main, extra = layers under it, plugin = a sound object with no media (vibration or silence)
how_to_read.summary.main_media_replaceable: main media of all three variants minus haptics minus anything another hero's bank also holds; this is what a make_sounds 'replace' list would be
how_to_read.summary.extra_layers_magneto_only: layers under the main that only Magneto banks hold (mute or replace them together with the main)
how_to_read.summary.media_shared_with_other_heroes: never touch (see never_touch): Wwise indexes in-bank media by id across loaded banks, first loaded copy wins, so changing them can change other heroes
how_to_read.vanilla: plain description of the vanilla sound. NOT listened to: the bank is Wwise Vorbis and this PC has no WEM Vorbis decoder (no vgmstream/ww2ogg, no packed codebook file; ffmpeg cannot read Wwise Vorbis). Descriptions come from the dev comments in the SoundTable, event names, lengths, layering and the ability itself
how_to_read.summary.variants_muted_by_mix: variants whose main sits at about -100 dB in the mix (a -96 dB volume or make-up gain on a parent), i.e. that listener group does not hear it (mostly the _p2 ally versions of passive rings, reload ring spins, Q absorb, Space descent, the Magnetic Resonance end). Leave them alone or silence them; do NOT level a clip against that volume (make_sounds would add ~100 dB of gain)
